usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.conversations.items.create("conv_123", items=[{"role": "user", "content": "string", "phase": "commentary", "type": "message"}], include=["file_search_call.results"])
print(result)

fields.name: items
fields.description: The items to add to the conversation. You may add up to 20 items at a time.

fields.name: include
fields.description:
Additional fields to include in the response. See the `include`
parameter for [listing Conversation items above](/docs/api-reference/conversations/list-items#conversations_list_items-include) for more information.
